style: architect-owner's colourful lifestyle sketch on scanned sketch paper. Rough thick black marker wall lines, colored-pencil hatching that fills each room with a different soft hue, visible pencil grain and slightly uneven strokes, hand-drawn furniture with lived-in clutter — books, plants, toys, a drying rack, small daily objects. Dense but cheerful; it should look drawn by hand in one sitting, not printed.
composition: strict orthographic top-down 2D floor plan, no perspective, no isometric, no 3D. The plan fills the frame with even margins of blank sketch paper. Vertical portrait orientation.
negatives: sales-poster polish, glossy gradients, drop shadows
CAD-drawing look: thin uniform line weights, hatching legends, grid paper
furniture blocking a door opening or a main circulation path
adding rooms, gardens, cat areas, esports rooms or gyms that are not in the source plan
dimension lines, measurement arrows, scale bars, north arrows, legends
